open_items: ILO gateway_issue, cycle 268 (2026-08-16T12:01:22Z): gateway metadata failed HTTP 500 on list_dataflows while direct path was healthy. Still open at report time (12:44Z). Live recheck ~40min later showed the same direct URL also failing 500 with a different error body (missing indicator codelist entry), suggesting provider-side flakiness on ILO's dataflow-listing endpoint rather than a stable gateway-only bug, though the monitor's own classification is gateway_issue. First occurrence of this exact pattern (500 on gateway metadata specifically) in this endpoint's catalogued history. Preceded immediately by a broader-than-usual direct-403 episode at cycle 267 (all three direct checks failed, not just direct metadata as in prior occurrences). Watch cycles 269/270; escalate as a real gateway-side bug only if gateway metadata keeps failing while direct stays healthy across more than one cycle.

ILO direct-path 403 flap (basic checks): ninth occurrence, cycle 267 (2026-08-16T10:01:22Z), broader than prior occurrences: all three direct checks failed (metadata, data, json), not just direct metadata. Resolved by cycle 268. Prior occurrences (single-check) cycle 32, 94, 159, 166, 202, 238, 244, 249. Watch for a tenth occurrence; escalate if a future episode spans more than one cycle or recurs at this broader scope.

ILO blanket-403 provider_down episode: fourth occurrence was cycle 264, resolved within the cycle. Clean through cycle 268 (no fifth occurrence yet). Prior occurrences cycle 244, 251, 260. Watch for a fifth occurrence; escalate for real if metadata+data failure recurs again on a similarly short interval or an episode spans more than one cycle.
